column1: # Ordered preferences between analyses. Each row counts on a path; paths are compared rank by rank, smaller
# count first, and the first rank that differs decides (rank 1 is compared first). Rows of one rank add up.
# kind: unk (an unknown-word arc), derived (a derived spoken arc, ja/derive.tsv), join (a word read across a
# space), arc (a dictionary arc whose form matches `select`), pair (a token matching `select` followed by one
# matching `next`). Selectors as in ja/conn.tsv; arc rows also know surf, len, hira, kata, kana, kanji, alnum,
# kanaspell (a kana form of a lemma written in kanji), hiraspell (a hiragana form of a lemma not written in
# hiragana), variant (a kanji not in the lemma), goshu, pos1; lemma is known for every arc.
# weight (optional, default 1): the count a row adds within its rank; rank 6 uses it to order parts of speech.
